final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS avg_step1 FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_conf, s.avg_conf - t.avg_step1 AS excess FROM step1 AS s JOIN step2 AS t ON t.avg_step1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s.avg_conf > t.avg_step1), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS avg_step3 FROM step3) SELECT s.brokrepstat, s.avg_conf, s.excess, s.avg_conf / t.avg_step3 FROM step3 AS s JOIN step4 AS t ON t.avg_step3 IS NOT NULL
